blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Far Eastern University took advantage of Ateneo playing without its head coach to notch a convincing 93-70 win in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Araneta Coliseum on Saturday. The Tamaraws won their fourth straight game for a league-leading 4-1 record while sending the Blue Eagles, who were without the suspended coach Louie Alas, to a second straight setback. After trailing 27-23 at the end of the opening quarter, FEU opened the second with an 11-0 run to take a 34-27 lead with 6:52 left in the period. The […]...
